scope: Code inspection, current vendor documentation, existing live smoke metrics and controlled in-memory reproductions. No live deployment or source implementation changes.

overlappingDelivery.notes: Two overlapping attempts for one generation returned different synthetic vision descriptions; the late attempt overwrote the published extraction before its commit was rejected.

visionReplay.notes: A simulated embedding failure after successful vision caused every redelivery to describe the same image again.

decorativePagesConsumeCap.notes: The first two PDF pages contained only border drawing paths. The third contained the actual chart.

configuredOCRWithoutText.notes: An image-only PDF with usable vector graphics was refused before visual extraction when the configured OCR test double returned no text.
